crossRefs.note: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.
Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.
Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, hear with…
For this people’s heart has grown callous. Their ears are dull of hearing. Their eyes they have closed. Lest they…
I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.
Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.
I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”
For I delight in God’s law after the inward man,

translations.web: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.
translations.bsb: Their hearts are callous and insensitive, but I delight in Your law.
translations.kjv: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.
translations.asv: Their heart is as fat as grease; But I delight in thy law.
